```yaml
name: Copilot Agent Setup

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Setup Rust toolchain
        uses: oxc-project/setup-rust@cd82e1efec7fef815e2c23d296756f31c7cdc03d # v1.0.0
        with:
          cache-key: copilot-setup
          tools: just,cargo-binstall

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: oxc-project/setup-node@f42e3bda950c7454575e78ee4eaac880a077700c # v1.0.0

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: |
          corepack enable
          pnpm --version

      - name: Install development tools with cargo-binstall
        run: |
          cargo binstall watchexec-cli cargo-insta typos-cli cargo-shear dprint -y

      - name: Install Node.js dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Verify tool installations
        run: |
          echo "Checking just version..."
          just --version
          
          echo "Checking cargo-binstall version..."
          cargo binstall --version
          
          echo "Checking watchexec version..."
          watchexec --version
          
          echo "Checking cargo-insta version..."
          cargo insta --version
          
          echo "Checking typos version..."
          typos --version
          
          echo "Checking cargo-shear version..."
          cargo shear --version
          
          echo "Checking dprint version..."
          dprint --version
          
          echo "Checking Node.js version..."
          node --version
          
          echo "Checking pnpm version..."
          pnpm --version

      - name: Run cargo check
        run: cargo check

      - name: Completion message
        run: |
          echo "✅ Copilot agent environment setup complete!"
          echo ""
          echo "Available commands:"
          echo "  just ready     - Run all project checks"
          echo "  just fmt       - Format code"
          echo "  just test      - Run tests"
          echo "  just lint      - Run linter"
          echo "  just check     - Run cargo check"
          echo ""
          echo "Tools installed:"
          echo "  - Rust toolchain (1.88.0)"
          echo "  - Node.js (22.14.0)"
          echo "  - pnpm (10.13.1)"
          echo "  - just"
          echo "  - cargo-binstall"
          echo "  - watchexec-cli"
          echo "  - cargo-insta"
          echo "  - typos-cli"
          echo "  - cargo-shear"
          echo "  - dprint"
```
